name: logenxoval
description: LogEnxoval — PWA offline-first de controle do enxoval de caminhões-oficina

scripts.build: npm run build -w @logenxoval/contracts && npm run build -w @logenxoval/server && npm run build -w @logenxoval/pwa
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @logenxoval/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @logenxoval/server && npm run typecheck -w @logenxoval/pwa
scripts.test: npm run test -w @logenxoval/server && npm run test -w @logenxoval/pwa
scripts.build:cloud: npm run build -w @logenxoval/contracts && npm run build -w @logenxoval/server && npm run typecheck:api && npm run build -w @logenxoval/pwa && npm run migrate:cloud && npm run seed:cloud
